node.title: Re^4: Grab input from the user and Open the file
node.author: valerydolce
node.doctext:
Since I haven't explored modules, i used an if statement to match all possible URLs as shown below:

if (m/^(((ht|f)tp(s?))\://)?(www.|[a-zA-Z].)[a-zA-Z0-9\-\.]+\.(com|edu|gov|m +il|net|org|biz|info|name|museum|us|ca|uk)(\:[0-9]+)*(/($|[a-zA-Z0-9\. +\,\;\?\'\\\+&%\$#\=~_\-]+))*$/){ my($host,$path) = ($4,$5); print "$host => $path\n"; }

I'm having the following error after testing Unmatched ( in regex; marked by <-- HERE in m/^( <-- HERE ((ht|f)tp(s?))\:/ at challenge2.pl line 44.
